cases.name: responsive-checkout-geometry
cases.agent_response:
Updated `lib/checkout_screen.dart` to wrap controls, reserve footer space, allow the full error to reflow, and constrain wide layouts. Preserved the avatar badge and Place order behavior.

Tests were blocked by SDK cache write permissions. No verification files or package configuration were changed.
